axisConvention.box: L = length, W = width/depth, H = height; unlabelled box triples retain conventional listed L×W×H order.
axisConvention.paper-bag: L = front width, W = gusset depth, H = body height excluding handles. Unlabeled supplier axis order stays partial.
axisConvention.bowl-cup: L and W = outer top diameter footprint; H = body height; topDiameter/bottomDiameter drive vessel taper.
axisConvention.cutlery-straw: length = longitudinal size, also stored as L; W and H describe transverse extents.
axisConvention.sheet-sticker: L and W = two-dimensional design extent; H = estimated display thickness.

statusDefinitions.exact-published: Published nominal size sufficient for the principal geometry axes, or an explicitly selected two-dimensional variant. Small structural details may still be estimated.
statusDefinitions.partial: Some published measurements exist, but required axes or shape parameters are incomplete or unlabeled.
statusDefinitions.conflicting: Published size declarations disagree; all conflicting measurements are preserved.
statusDefinitions.unspecified: No usable published physical dimensions for this product or grouped arrangement.

referencePolicy: References are public official Pacdora links followed from the cited page, not extracted engine files. All product matches remain candidates pending structural verification. No Pacdora match is invented for cutlery, straws, bundles or sample groups.
